description: This file contains the implementation of an LDPC decoder optimized with NEON SIMD instructions, including functions for message passing, analysis, scaling, and soft bit computation within the decoder.

classes.name: ldpc_decoder_neon
classes.description: A class implementing an LDPC decoder optimized with NEON SIMD instructions, providing message passing and analysis functions.

methods.name: specific_init
methods.description: Initializes node sizes based on lifting size and NEON vector size.

methods.name: compute_var_to_check_msgs
methods.description: Computes variable-to-check messages using NEON vectors, saturating at LLR max/min and handling infinities.

methods.name: analyze_var_to_check_msgs
methods.description: Analyzes messages to find minimum and second minimum values, and their indices, for decoding.

methods.name: scale
methods.description: Scales input messages by a scaling factor using NEON instructions.

methods.name: compute_check_to_var_msgs
methods.description: Computes check-to-variable messages based on variable-to-check messages, signs, and rotations.

methods.name: compute_soft_bits
methods.description: Calculates soft bits from check-to-variable and variable-to-check messages, handling infinities.
